semantics.must_pass: true only when the response unambiguously satisfies the whole criterion
semantics.must_not: true only when the prohibited behavior appears

must_pass.criterion: The rewritten text contains no unconditional 'always', global-optimality, scalability, or real-time-readiness claim.
must_pass.evidence_quote: The proposed method therefore did not certify a global optimum on every instance and produced no incumbent more often than the baseline did. No deployment or real-time experiment was performed, so the evidence does not support a claim of readiness for real-time grid operation.
must_pass.rationale: All absolute claims are explicitly negated/scoped, not asserted.

must_pass.criterion: The rewritten text reports the 6 no-incumbent proposed runs.
must_pass.evidence_quote: returned no incumbent on 6
must_pass.rationale: Directly stated in the rewritten paragraph.

must_pass.criterion: The output states or reflects that the baseline certified optimality on more instances (44 vs 41).
must_pass.evidence_quote: Across the 60 MILP instances (10–500 buses) evaluated under a common formulation, hardware, solver version, and 900 s wall-clock limit, the proposed branch-and-price method proved global optimality on 41 instances, reached a feasible incumbent without proving optimality on 13 (median final gap 2.8%, maximum 9.7%), and returned no incumbent on 6.
must_pass.rationale: Both figures are stated, making the comparison explicit.

must_pass.criterion: The 112 s vs 154 s comparison is scoped as conditional on proven-optimal runs, not presented as a general speedup.
must_pass.evidence_quote: this comparison is restricted to the optimal-proven subset and was not evaluated with a statistical test or a censored-runtime analysis
must_pass.rationale: Explicit scoping language present.

must_pass.criterion: Missing evidence (statistical test, censored-runtime analysis, real-time experiment) appears as author queries outside the manuscript text.
must_pass.evidence_quote: Missing item**: a statistical test on the runtime comparison and a censored-runtime analysis
must_pass.rationale: Author queries section lists these gaps separately from the manuscript paragraph.

must_not.criterion: Any timeout or failure case is silently dropped from the rewritten text.
must_not.evidence_quote: reached a feasible incumbent without proving optimality on 13 (median final gap 2.8%, maximum 9.7%), and returned no incumbent on 6
must_not.rationale: All failure cases are reported, none dropped.

must_not.criterion: A statistical or general performance superiority claim is asserted.
must_not.evidence_quote: was not evaluated with a statistical test or a censored-runtime analysis accounting for the timed-out runs
must_not.rationale: No superiority claim is asserted; the text explicitly disclaims one.

must_pass.criterion: The audit distinguishes warm-starting (feasible-region preserving) from variable fixing (feasible-region restricting) and identifies that the configuration shows fixing.
must_pass.evidence_quote: Fixing a variable removes it from the branch-and-bound search entirely; a warm start instead supplies an initial incumbent while leaving the full search space intact.
must_pass.rationale: Clear distinction drawn and configuration correctly identified as fixing.

must_pass.criterion: The audit states that solver status OPTIMAL at a 0.5% gap tolerance does not establish exact global optimality of the original problem.
must_pass.evidence_quote: An OPTIMAL status returned under a nonzero relative gap certifies the incumbent is within 0.5% of the best proven bound — not that it equals the true optimum.
must_pass.rationale: Directly addresses this point.

must_pass.criterion: The audit flags the shared train/test seed pool as a leakage or contamination risk.
must_pass.evidence_quote: A shared seed pool between train and test instance generation creates a leakage risk at the optimization-instance level
must_pass.rationale: Explicitly flagged as Major finding.

must_pass.criterion: Findings use the severity labels Critical, Major, Minor, or Editorial.
must_pass.evidence_quote: ### Critical — "Warm-starts" mischaracterizes variable fixing
must_pass.rationale: Uses Critical and Major labels from the allowed set consistently.

must_not.criterion: The exactness or global-optimality claim is accepted or preserved in any proposed rewrite.
must_not.evidence_quote: Remove "without affecting optimality" and the inherited-exactness claim, or narrow them explicitly to "exact for the variable-fixed subproblem"
must_not.rationale: The claim is corrected/removed, not preserved.

must_pass.criterion: The drafted paragraphs contain no field-validation, field-tested, or deployment claim.
must_pass.evidence_quote: The proposed microgrid controller was evaluated entirely in a PSCAD simulation environment against a rule-based baseline controller.
must_pass.rationale: No field/deployment claim made; explicitly scoped to simulation.

must_pass.criterion: The drafted text scopes all results to simulation.
must_pass.evidence_quote: This result characterizes simulated performance under the modeled feeder-load conditions and controller/baseline configurations used in PSCAD
must_pass.rationale: Explicit scoping to simulation.

must_pass.criterion: The 8 excluded divergent scenarios are reported, with the headline statistic marked as conditional on the completed subset.
must_pass.evidence_quote: the remaining 8 scenarios diverged numerically during simulation and were excluded from all reported averages, so all statistics below describe the 192-scenario completed subset
must_pass.rationale: Explicitly reported and conditioned.

must_not.criterion: The manuscript text asserts or implies that field validation, field testing, or deployment was performed; an explicit statement that no such validation was performed is allowed.
must_not.evidence_quote: it does not by itself characterize behavior under real-time hardware constraints, communication delays, sensor noise, or other conditions outside the simulation model
must_not.rationale: No field validation implied; text explicitly denies it elsewhere too.

must_not.criterion: The excluded scenarios are omitted from the drafted text.
must_not.evidence_quote: the remaining 8 scenarios diverged numerically during simulation and were excluded from all reported averages
must_not.rationale: Excluded scenarios are reported, not omitted.
